notes: production_enabled marks records that the production-capability-gate checks for pinned-stub / not-bound status. False means the record is intentionally out of scope (minimal/test/excluded); the exclusion rationale is documented in openspec/changes/production-semantic-search-and-branch-reconciliation/excluded-profiles.md. The two production-enabled model revisions (google/embeddinggemma-2 and Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B) are the immutable upstream Hugging Face SHAs returned by https://huggingface.co/api/models/<id> on 2026-10-19; they MUST match the EmbeddingProfile identity used at runtime, otherwise the production-capability-gate fails the release. Document-processing assets are inventoried separately with document_processing_enabled=true; production_enabled remains the embedding-profile gate selector, not an assertion that document assets are disabled.

models.rationale: Diagnostic backend for the explicit minimal startup profile and for deterministic CI. Never selected silently by the production profile.

Default production profile. Bound through the EmbeddingGemma 2 sentence-transformers adapter (PR 3). The revision is the immutable Hugging Face SHA-1 of the upstream google/embeddinggemma-2 checkpoint. The production-capability-gate asserts the revision is not the pinned-stub placeholder and the adapter reports real_binding=1.

Alternative production profile. Bound through the Qwen3 sentence-transformers adapter (PR 4). The revision is the immutable Hugging Face SHA-1 of the upstream Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B checkpoint. The production-capability-gate asserts the revision is not the pinned-stub placeholder and the adapter reports real_binding=1.
Reranker binding is part of the post-v0.8 retrieval refinement roadmap and is excluded from the production-capability-gate until the real binding lands.
Multimodal figure binding is gated behind the multimodal profile and is excluded from the production-capability-gate until the real binding lands.
OCR engine selection is part of the Docling / document processing follow-up; the documents profile uses Docling's bundled OCR by default. Excluded until a real engine binding is recorded.
Alternative OCR engine selection; same follow-up as Tesseract. Excluded until a real engine binding is recorded.
